concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-005 mandates that at least 60 % of the top‑20 substructures overlap a curated reference set (Supplementary Table S1) and exceed a random‑baseline enrichment. The original idea only required identification of influential substructures; it did not specify a quantitative external‑reference validation. This adds a new research requirement not present in the idea and therefore constitutes scope over‑reach.

Functional Requirement FR-016 obliges the creation of a curated reference set of fluorophore motifs independent of the training data. The idea’s research question does not call for such an external motif library; it only asks for attribution of substructures. Requiring this library expands the project beyond the stated scientific goal.
